title: Comparatives — cheaper / bigger
explanation: Use comparatives to compare two things. Add -er for short adjectives (cheap → cheaper). Use more for longer adjectives.
explanationIt: Usa i comparativi per confrontare due cose. Aggiungi -er agli aggettivi brevi (cheap → cheaper). Usa more per aggettivi più lunghi.
realUse: This bread is cheaper than that one.
The shop is closer than the supermarket.

options: This milk is cheaper than that one.
This milk is more cheap than that one.
This milk is cheap than that one.
This milk is the cheaper than that one.
